root_cause: The language runtime allowed English selection and partial translation success even when one or more website strings were unresolved. It also skipped option text and several user-facing attributes, so the page could legally end in a mixed Dutch/English state.
prevention: English activation is atomic: do not persist or confirm the English locale until every meaningful source string on the current document has a translation result.
Retry unresolved strings individually after bounded batch retries before declaring translation incomplete.
Treat same-source translations as valid coverage for terms that are identical in Dutch and English.
Translate user-facing option text plus placeholder, title, aria-label, alt and submit/button/reset value attributes.
On incomplete coverage, revert to the prior locale instead of leaving a mixed-language page.
evidence: user requirement 2026-09-21: after clicking English the entire website must be English
